_meta.indication: Ph+ CML in chronic phase previously treated with two or more TKIs (accelerated approval based on MMR); and Ph+ CML in CP with the T315I mutation

pivotal_trials.trial_name: ASCEMBL (CABL001A2301, referred to as study A2301)
pivotal_trials.design: Randomized (2:1), open-label, active controlled trial of asciminib monotherapy versus bosutinib monotherapy, stratified by baseline cytogenetic response status (with or without MCyR)
pivotal_trials.population: Adults with Ph+ CML in chronic phase, previously treated with two or more TKIs; T315I or V299L mutation patients excluded
pivotal_trials.endpoint: MMR (BCR-ABL1 ratio ≤ 0.1% on the International Scale) at 24 weeks
pivotal_trials.result: MMR at 24 weeks 25% (95% CI: 19, 33) asciminib vs 13% (95% CI: 6.5, 23) bosutinib; treatment difference 12% (95% CI: 2.2, 22); two-sided p=0.029

pivotal_trials.design: Non-randomized, open-label, dose escalation, first-in-human study of asciminib monotherapy; T315I cohort dosed at 200 mg twice daily
pivotal_trials.population: Ph+ CML-CP with the T315I mutation, all previously treated with at least one prior BCR-ABL TKI
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Cumulative MMR by 24 weeks (and by 96 weeks)
pivotal_trials.n: 45 patients (T315I efficacy population at 200 mg twice daily)
pivotal_trials.result: MMR achieved by 24 weeks in 42% (95% CI: 28, 58) and by 96 weeks in 49% (95% CI: 34, 64) of the 45 patients

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (≥20%) are upper respiratory tract infections, musculoskeletal pain, fatigue, nausea, rash, and diarrhea. In ASCEMBL, upper respiratory tract infection 26%, musculoskeletal pain 22%, headache 19%, fatigue 17%. Warnings include myelosuppression, pancreatic toxicity, hypertension, hypersensitivity, and cardiovascular toxicity (occurred in 46 (13%) of 356 patients).
target_moa: Asciminib is an ABL/BCR-ABL1 tyrosine kinase inhibitor that binds to the ABL myristoyl pocket of BCR-ABL1 (allosteric STAMP inhibition), unlike other TKIs that bind the ATP site; active against wild-type BCR-ABL1 and mutant forms including T315I

advisory_committee.vote: Not presented to the Oncologic Drug Advisory Committee because the application did not raise significant safety or efficacy issues
